title: AMS_ADRN at SemEval-2022 Task 5: A Suitable Image-text Multimodal Joint Modeling Method for Multi-task Misogyny Identification
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of a system for classifying misogynous content in memes. While it addresses a social and ethical harm (misogyny), it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, specific moral philosophies, or ethics as defined in the prompt.
